error-message.name: error-message
error-message.description: Displays an error message with an enter/leave animation. Used standalone or by form components.

button.name: button
button.description: A button with variants, sizes, a loading state, and leading/trailing icon slots.

split-button.name: split-button
split-button.description: A primary action with a caret that opens a menu of secondary actions -- native button segments styled directly against Button's own design tokens, merged into one shape via a shared flex row rather than composing separate Button instances. Composes Popover for the menu.

toggle-button.name: toggle-button
toggle-button.description: A two-state button supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms -- unpressed reads outlined, pressed fills solid, reusing Button's own variant tokens.

speed-dial.name: speed-dial
speed-dial.description: A floating action button that expands into a linear (up/down/left/right) list of mini action buttons -- composes Button for the trigger. Closes on outside click, Escape, or picking an action.

toggle-group.name: toggle-group
toggle-group.description: A segmented control of Toggle-Button-styled segments -- single-select (exclusive, click again to clear) by default, or multiple for independent per-segment toggling. Supports ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms.

text-input.name: text-input
text-input.description: A text input supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Angular signal forms.

float-label.name: float-label
float-label.description: A floating label wrapper for any SemiUI field -- merges PrimeNG's FloatLabel and IftaLabel into one component via a variant input (over/on/in). Pure CSS, no JS state tracking; uses ViewEncapsulation.None to read the projected field's focus/filled state.

icon-field.name: icon-field
icon-field.description: A container that adds a leading or trailing icon to any SemiUI field -- project the field as content and it reserves room for the icon. Uses ViewEncapsulation.None to reach the projected field's own padding.

auto-complete.name: auto-complete
auto-complete.description: A free-text input with a filtered suggestions panel -- the bound value is whatever's typed, not constrained to the option list. Client-side filtering by default; feed options from the (search) output for async/server-driven suggestions.

password.name: password
password.description: A password input with a show/hide toggle, built on the same form integrations as text-input.

select.name: select
select.description: A listbox select with search/filter, a clear button, viewport-aware panel placement, and custom templates for the trigger, options, icon, header, and footer.

cascade-select.name: cascade-select
cascade-select.description: A hierarchical select: each level's children open as an adjacent column, same trigger/panel chrome as Select. Only leaf nodes are selectable; the trigger shows the full label path.

switch.name: switch
switch.description: A toggle switch supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with sm/md/lg sizes and optional on/off icons.

checkbox.name: checkbox
checkbox.description: A checkbox supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with sm/md/lg sizes and an indeterminate state.

radio-group.name: radio-group
radio-group.description: A radio group supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with the same options/optionLabel/optionValue shape as Select.

textarea.name: textarea
textarea.description: A multi-line text input supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with optional auto-resize and a character counter.

input-number.name: input-number
input-number.description: A numeric input supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with min/max/step, increment/decrement buttons, and prefix/suffix text.

otp.name: otp
otp.description: A one-time-password input supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with auto-advancing digit boxes and paste support.

multiselect.name: multiselect
multiselect.description: A multi-select listbox supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with search/filter, chips, select all/clear all, and viewport-aware panel placement.

popover.name: popover
popover.description: A popover controlled by reference from anywhere in the template (po.toggle($event)/show($event)/hide()), positioned against whatever triggered it.

tooltip.name: tooltip
tooltip.description: A [sTooltip] directive that shows a small floating label on hover/focus of any element.

divider.name: divider
divider.description: A horizontal or vertical rule, with an optional centered label.

skeleton.name: skeleton
skeleton.description: A shimmering loading placeholder block, with rect/circle/text shapes.

avatar.name: avatar
avatar.description: An image avatar with initials/icon fallback, sizes, circle/square shape, and a status dot.

tag.name: tag
tag.description: A small label/chip with color variants, an optional leading icon, and a removable state.

breadcrumb.name: breadcrumb
breadcrumb.description: A trail of ancestor pages, using Angular's RouterLink for navigable items.

pagination.name: pagination
pagination.description: Page-number buttons with prev/next and optional first/last, collapsing to an ellipsis for large page counts.

rating.name: rating
rating.description: A star rating supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms -- clicking the currently-selected star clears it.

badge.name: badge
badge.description: A small notification indicator (count, "N+", or a dot) that overlays projected content, or renders inline in standalone mode.

accordion.name: accordion
accordion.description: A data-driven accordion with a required #content template slot per item, an optional custom #header slot, single- or multiple-open modes, and a pure-CSS expand/collapse animation.

tabs.name: tabs
tabs.description: A data-driven tab strip with a required #content template slot, an optional custom #label slot, horizontal/vertical orientation, a measured sliding indicator, and roving-tabindex keyboard navigation.

rich-text-editor.name: rich-text-editor
rich-text-editor.description: A contenteditable-based WYSIWYG editor -- value is HTML markup, works with ngModel/reactive forms/Signal Forms like any other field. Formatting runs through document.execCommand (deprecated but universally supported, avoids a third-party editor dependency). Toolbar icons are raw inline SVG defined in the recipe itself, not the shared icon token set. toolbar picks which built-in tools show.

image-cropper.name: image-cropper
image-cropper.description: A pan/zoom image cropper -- a fixed crop frame stays put while the image is dragged and zoomed underneath it (the common avatar-upload pattern), rather than a movable/resizable rectangle over a static image. getCroppedDataUrl()/getCroppedBlob() render the current crop via canvas. src is a plain URL/data-URI string -- file selection is left to File Upload or a plain <input type="file"> elsewhere. The zoom control is the library's own Slider component, not a native <input type="range">.

context-menu.name: context-menu
context-menu.description: A right-click menu anchored at the cursor, with nested submenus (opened on hover, any depth) -- wrap anything in <s-context-menu>. The recursive submenu rendering (ContextMenuPanelComponent) imports itself via forwardRef, the standard Angular pattern for a standalone component referencing its own not-yet-initialized class in its own imports array.

full-calendar.name: full-calendar
full-calendar.description: A month/week calendar grid with events -- pass events (title + start, optional end/color). Month view shows up to maxEventsPerDay pills per day plus a "+N more" count; week view lists every event per day in an agenda-style column, not an hour-by-hour time grid. Purely display/navigation -- dayClick/eventClick hand off to the consumer to act on.

organization-chart.name: organization-chart
organization-chart.description: A hierarchical tree of nodes connected by lines -- pass a single root node (data plus optional children, recursively). Each node renders as a card with an expand/collapse toggle when it has children; selectionMode adds click/keyboard selection. The recursive per-node rendering (OrganizationChartNodeComponent) imports itself via forwardRef, the same pattern Context Menu's own recursive submenu uses. Connector lines are drawn with the classic ul/li CSS-tree technique adapted to these custom elements, written entirely in inline-* logical properties so it mirrors correctly under RTL. #node template slot for custom node content.

marquee.name: marquee
marquee.description: A continuously scrolling content loop -- pure CSS (a duplicated copy of the projected content, animated -50% along the scroll axis), no JS measuring/cloning. Horizontal or vertical, pause-on-hover.

scroll-top.name: scroll-top
scroll-top.description: A floating action button that appears once the page has scrolled past a threshold, and scrolls back to the top on click. Native button styled against Button's own variant tokens, not a composed <s-button>.

progress-bar.name: progress-bar
progress-bar.description: A linear progress indicator -- determinate (value 0-100) or indeterminate (unbounded loading loop). color reuses Button's own variant tokens rather than owning a separate palette.

splitter.name: splitter
splitter.description: Resizable panes divided by a draggable gutter -- panels are ng-template sSplitterPanel children, gathered via contentChildren and rendered (interleaved with gutters) by the splitter itself, since plain content projection can't interleave elements between projected children on its own. Sized via flex-grow rather than a literal percentage width, so gutters' own pixel width never pushes the total past 100%. Drag or arrow-key a gutter to resize; horizontal or vertical.

tree-table.name: tree-table
tree-table.description: A hierarchical data table -- pass columns and nodes (each wrapping row data plus optional children). The first column gets a depth indent and expand/collapse toggle; every other column renders like Table's own, reusing its tokens directly. Narrower than Table: no sorting/filtering/pagination. #cell template slot for custom rendering.

timeline.name: timeline
timeline.description: A vertical or horizontal sequence of events -- each item is title/content/date/icon/color, all optional. Reuses Stepper's own marker/connector/label tokens (a timeline is structurally the same shape, without progress state) and Button's variant tokens for per-item marker color. #content/#marker template slots override per-entry rendering.

stepper.name: stepper
stepper.description: A step progress indicator with completed/active/upcoming states, linear (no-skip-ahead) mode, horizontal/vertical orientation, and an optional #content template slot for the active step's panel.

slider.name: slider
slider.description: A single-thumb range slider with drag/click-to-jump/keyboard support, tick marks, a floating value bubble, horizontal/vertical orientation, and ngModel/reactive forms support.

dialog.name: dialog
dialog.description: A modal dialog controlled by reference (show()/hide()/toggle()), always portaled to document.body, with focus trap, background scroll lock, and focus restoration on close. Includes a DialogService for opening any component in a dialog imperatively, PrimeNG DynamicDialog-style.

drawer.name: drawer
drawer.description: A panel that slides in from a viewport edge (left/right/top/bottom), controlled by reference (show()/hide()/toggle()) with the same focus trap/scroll lock/portal behavior as Dialog.

file-upload.name: file-upload
file-upload.description: A drag-and-drop / click-to-browse file picker with accept/maxFileSize/maxFiles validation, image thumbnail previews, and ngModel/reactive/Signal Forms support.

toast.name: toast
toast.description: A ToastService (injectable anywhere) plus a <s-toast-container> to mount once in your app root -- success()/error()/warning()/info() helpers, auto-dismiss with pause-on-hover, positioned corners.

carousel.name: carousel
carousel.description: A single-slide-at-a-time carousel with a required #slide template slot, autoplay (paused on hover), looping, arrow keys, and pointer-drag/swipe.

date-picker.name: date-picker
date-picker.description: A calendar date picker with an inline option (no popover, calendar always visible), min/max/custom date disabling, keyboard grid navigation, and ngModel/reactive/Signal Forms support.

color-picker.name: color-picker
color-picker.description: A hex color picker: saturation/value square, hue slider, typeable hex field, preset swatches, an inline option, and ngModel/reactive/Signal Forms support.

table.name: table
table.description: A data-driven table with optional per-column sorting, a global filter box (via <s-text-input>), single/multiple row selection (via <s-checkbox>), a rows-per-page dropdown (via <s-select>), a "Showing X to Y of Z" summary, #cell/#header/#footer/#loading templates, and built-in pagination via <s-pagination>.

chart.name: chart
chart.description: An SVG chart supporting line, bar, area, pie, and donut via a type input -- no canvas, no external charting library. Gridlines/axes and a clickable legend for cartesian types, hover tooltips for all types.

knob.name: knob
knob.description: A radial gauge: a circular progress ring showing where value sits between min and max, with the formatted value (and an optional label) centered inside. Adapted from PrimeNG's Knob but deliberately not a form control -- no drag-to-set interaction, no ControlValueAccessor. A chart type (the radial counterpart to Chart's pie/donut) for displaying a metric, not collecting one.
